entities.name: Genesis Storm

identity.fantasy: An Absolute storm grows temporary structures, traversal routes, wildlife habitats, and encounter geometry from luminous blueprint rain, then tests whether players can use what it created before it dissolves.
identity.silhouette: White-gold storm clouds raining geometric wireframes that become short-lived trees, bridges, towers, caves, and platforms.
identity.lore_hook: The storm is not weather. It is a world trying several drafts at once.

signature: Blueprint Rain selects from a bounded library of prebuilt temporary structures valid for the current region.
Genesis Routes create alternate traversal networks and hidden objective access without modifying core terrain permanently.
Created Ecology temporarily introduces compatible wildlife and resource nodes tied to the generated structure set.
Revision Phase removes selected structures in a telegraphed order, forcing route adaptation.
Final Draft opens one rare Absolute crafting objective if players completed enough creation challenges before dissolution.
counterplay: Read revision warnings, avoid depending on one route, and prioritize structures tied to desired rewards.

entities.name: Zero Echo

identity.fantasy: A vanishingly rare Absolute event that appears only to qualified Zero Candidates and tests mastery through echoes of prior systems without itself granting Transcendent Zero.
identity.silhouette: The region loses most color while faint copies of past bosses, routes, faction banners, and crafting symbols overlap like memories.
identity.lore_hook: Before Zero chooses anyone, the world asks whether the candidate remembers what it cost to arrive.

signature: Echo Ledger selects authored mechanics from previously completed content rather than copying entire encounters.
No New Lesson combines familiar rules in unfamiliar pairings, testing understanding rather than hidden trivia.
Burden Recall temporarily requires candidate-crafted relics or materials to activate optional shortcuts without consuming irreplaceable items.
Witnesses allows squadmates to support objectives while reserving candidate-only mastery checks for the eligible player.
Silent Verdict records completion into Zero Candidate progression but does not guarantee selection or ascension.
counterplay: There is no pay shortcut or brute-force damage solution; candidates must recognize systems and can retry after failure under controlled rules.
evolution: Event intensity escalates through authored phases and terminates cleanly with regional reset/reward state.

vfx: Past encounter motifs appear as translucent monochrome echoes.
Correct system recognition restores one color channel at a time.
Burden Recall projects ghost images of qualifying relics.
Witness support creates white rings around allied objectives.
Silent Verdict collapses every echo into a tiny black point that remains briefly above the candidate.
animation: Echo encounters use abbreviated but recognizable transition animations from prior systems.
Color restoration travels outward from completed objectives.
Final collapse reverses all active echo animations simultaneously.
Candidate-only checks use distinct slow hand-sign animations so squadmates can read the phase.
